# An item of a round ends stopped, and the owner starts it again with `beehave run <item>`, the command that the pause text names.
# The run of a tracker item runs the pipeline of the example, not a round. The round's next pass reads the new run: the row was stopped and is done.
# The first card call of the board refuses (exit code 2), so the item stops after its draft. The second call passes.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main seed
exec git -C seed add Makefile .gitignore
exec git -C seed -c user.name=seed -c user.email=seed@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git clone -q --bare seed remote.git
exec git --git-dir=remote.git branch integration/r1 main
exec git --git-dir=remote.git branch integration/s1 main

# The round branch is one commit ahead of the project base branch, so a worktree cut at the wrong branch shows.
exec git clone -q remote.git s1clone
exec git -C s1clone checkout -q -b integration/s1 origin/integration/s1
cp s1.txt s1clone/s1.txt
exec git -C s1clone add s1.txt
exec git -C s1clone -c user.name=seed -c user.email=seed@example.com commit -q -m 's1 moved'
exec git -C s1clone push -q origin integration/s1
exec git --git-dir=remote.git rev-parse integration/s1
cp stdout s1-tip

example remediation/workflow.star flow/workflow.star

mkdir forge
mkdir home
mkdir login
mkdir login/skills/the-review-skill
cp skill.md login/skills/the-review-skill/SKILL.md
env SWARM_REMOTE=$WORK/remote.git
env SWARM_FORGE=$WORK/forge
env HOME=$WORK/home

exec git config --file home/.gitconfig user.name e2e
exec git config --file home/.gitconfig user.email e2e@example.com
cp base forge/base
cp base forge/closing-ok
cp base forge/open-on-create

cp runners.star config/runners.star
subst fake/claude fake/remedy config/projects/round.star config/runners.star
chmod 755 fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/remedy

exec beehaveround item add round round/integration/s1 --title 'The round' --body-file round.txt
exec beehaveround item add round 432 --title 'The child' --body-file child.txt

exec beehaveround run round/integration/s1 round --workflow flow/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'Listed item 432 stopped at command:board'

# The round started the pipeline of item 432 once, and the board refused the card.
exec beehaveround status
stdout 'item-432-r1	stopped'
grep -count=1 '^plan$' calls.log
cmp plan-head-1 s1-tip
grep -count=1 '^board$' remedy-keys.log

# The local branch of the item is gone (a stopped item has no worktree), and the remote branch is back at the tip of the base branch of the project.
# The new attempt cuts the branch again at the base of the round, not at the base branch of the project.
exec sh remove.sh

# The documented command starts a new attempt of the item. It runs the pipeline: the plan agent runs again and the board call passes.
# The script keeps the exit status of the run for the later checks, so a wrong base fails the comparison of the head first.
exec sh restart.sh
cmp plan-head-2 s1-tip
grep 'item 432 finished' restart.out
grep -count=2 '^plan$' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^board$' remedy-keys.log
exec beehaveround status
stdout 'item-432-r2	done'

# The next pass of the round reads the new run: the row is done, not stopped, and the round lands the item. The pass after the landing finds the item closed.
exec beehaveround answer round/integration/s1 --as agent CONTINUE
waitstatus 'Listed item 432 is not in the queue'
exec beehaveround answer round/integration/s1 --as agent STOP
wait
stdout 'finished'

-- base --
integration/s1
-- round.txt --
The round of the stage.
-- child.txt --
Change one thing.
-- seed/Makefile --
check: ; @mkdir -p reports && echo '<testsuite tests="1"><testcase name="t"/></testsuite>' > reports/r.xml
-- seed/.gitignore --
reports/
-- s1.txt --
s1
-- remove.sh --
set -e
git -C state/repos/round branch -D 432
git --git-dir="$WORK/remote.git" update-ref refs/heads/432 refs/heads/integration/r1
-- restart.sh --
beehaveround run 432 round --workflow flow/workflow.star > restart.out 2>&1 || true
-- mutation.sh --
exit 0

    repo = "o/r",
    source = "file://@WORK@/remote.git",
    forge = "github",
    base_branch = "integration/r1",
    gate = "make check",
    test_report = "reports/*.xml",
    build_host = "build",
    host = host(provider = "ssh", disk_floor_gb = 50, slots = {"mutation": 1}, ssh = ssh(address = "10.0.0.5")),
    vars = {
        "round": {"base": "integration/s1", "owner": "agent", "owner_email": "agent@example.com", "lane_cap": 1, "fix_rounds": 2, "items": ["432"], "merge": True, "wait_hours": 72, "source_checkout": "/own/checkout"},
        "board": {"number": 3, "started": "In Progress", "merged": "Done"},
        "mutation_command": ["sh", "mutation.sh"],
        "review_skill": "the-review-skill",
    },
)

-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = --version ]; then echo "2.1.290 (Claude Code)"; exit 0; fi
prompt=$(cat)
field() { printf '%s\n' "$prompt" | sed -n "s/^$1=//p"; }
step=$(field step)
echo "$step" >> @WORK@/calls.log
echo '{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_skill","name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"the-review-skill"}}]}}'
echo '{"type":"user","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_skill","content":"Launching skill: the-review-skill"}]}}'
case $step in
  plan)
    git rev-parse HEAD > "@WORK@/plan-head-$(grep -c '^plan$' @WORK@/calls.log)"
    printf '{"regressions":"0"}\n' > "$(field write)"
    ;;
  review) printf '{"verdict":"approve","mechanism":"","regressions":"0","open":"","findings":[]}\n' > "$(field write)" ;;
  sync_review) printf '{"verdict":"approve"}\n' > "$(field write)" ;;
  sweep) printf '{"report":"# Report\\n"}\n' > "$(field write)" ;;
  implement)
    id=$(basename "$(pwd)")
    n=$(grep -c '^implement$' @WORK@/calls.log)
    echo "$id" > "$id-$n.txt"
    git add "$id-$n.txt"
    git -c user.name=dev -c user.email=agent@example.com commit -q -m "task $id attempt $n"
    git push -q origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$id"
    printf '{"report":"# Report\\n","uncaused":"[]"}\n' > "$(field write)"
    ;;
esac
echo '{"type":"result","subtype":"success","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
-- fake/remedy --
#!/bin/sh
# The remedy tool of the round. Its sync finds nothing to do. Its first board call refuses the card with exit code 2.
key=$1
echo "$*" >> @WORK@/remedy.log
echo "$key" >> @WORK@/remedy-keys.log
n=$(grep -c "^$key\$" @WORK@/remedy-keys.log)
case $key in
  sync) echo "state=current" ;;
  integration) echo "pr=3 state=OPEN" ;;
  board)
    if [ "$n" = 1 ]; then
      echo "the card is not in the column In Progress"
      exit 2
    fi
    ;;
esac
